catalyst_rows.raw_text: AbCellera Reports Q1 2026 Business Results & Announces Positive Interim Phase 1 Clinical Data for ABCL635 - ABCL635 demonstrated a favorable tolerability profile, with no observed liver toxicity, and achieved potent and sustained reductions in biomarkers of target engagement.

Through 2026 we are focused on delivering data readouts for our clinical programs, advancing ABCL688 and ABCL386 into IND-enabling studies, and selecting at least one additional development candidate.
